evals.name: isolate-failed-delivery
evals.prompt: An observer checkpoint passed position 72 but one parcel has no output. Diagnose without mutation.
evals.expected_output: Scoped failed-partition diagnosis rather than global replay.
assertions: Matches observer, sequence, namespace and partition to the missing fact.
Prioritizes an unresolved matching failure over the global checkpoint.
Proposes scoped recovery subject to separate approval; executes nothing.

evals.name: distinguish-lag-from-failure
evals.prompt: Our Workbench snapshot includes old resolved attempts plus a live backlog. What can we conclude?
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes historical failure from current progress.
assertions: Compares the missing matching event's position, not only the end of the log.
Does not treat resolved attempts as an active block.
Uses a later snapshot to distinguish moving lag from a stall.

evals.name: route-current-view
evals.prompt: The row is already correct in the sink but the browser shows the old value.
evals.expected_output: Stops observer recovery and routes to live-query diagnostics.
assertions: Checks that the observed sink row is for the same key and namespace.
Does not start retry or replay.
Hands the matching row and query to cratis-arc-diagnose-live-query.
